caption:
Figure 2: Overview of CVRoute. (a) Street-view semantics are routed to satellite-defined regions
for satellite-space prediction. (b) Cross-view entities are matched over multiple pose hypotheses and
fused through pose-marginalized nullable routing. (c) A training-only privileged relationship teacher
guides early routing and is gradually annealed out; inference uses only predicted relationships.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final CVRoute and read its caption and all independent pair checks. Both street/satellite branches, routing, output attribute map, all four routing steps, pose hypotheses q1-q3 and weights, predicted relationship matrix, NULL output, and training-only privileged teacher are intact. The original green dashed connector is extended through enlarged whitespace with the original arrowheads in the lower band retained. The new street-to-satellite title, annealing sentence, and pose/aggregation/nullable reading guide restate the caption. Scientific source bands are independently restored; no new teacher or inference dependency is introduced.
